# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 20 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-19 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level19_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 20 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-19 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-19, no
# domain spell-list contents. The PF1 CRB Cleric class table's level-20
# "Special" column is genuinely BLANK (verified independently against both
# d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror, byte-for-byte
# agreement on the full levels-16-through-20 block) — a pure ceiling raise,
# exactly mirroring the level-16/level-18 cycles' own pure ceiling raises:
# base attack bonus genuinely RISES to +15 (20 * 3 / 4 = 15, up from 14 at
# level 19); both good Fortitude/Will genuinely RISE to +12 (20 / 2 + 2 = 12,
# up from 11 at level 19); poor Reflex STAYS at +6 (20 / 3 = 6, an
# integer-division coincidence with level 19). Channel Energy's die count
# STAYS at 10d6 ((20 + 1) / 2 = 10, unchanged from level 19 — the odd-level
# rise cadence's last rise landed at level 19, and PF1 character levels do
# not go past 20, so no further rise is possible). The flat domain spell
# slot count STAYS 9 (a level-20 cleric still casts only up to 9th-level
# cleric spells, the highest cleric spell level in PF1). The Good domain's
# Touch of Good sacred bonus genuinely RISES to 10 (20 / 2 = 10, up from 9 at
# level 19) via the same pre-existing formula, not re-derived. This is the
# final level within PF1's 1-20 character-level cap for this class row.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level20
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:20
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
